question: Sonal Mansingh, the classical dance legend, has NOT received which of the following awards?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Padma Shri__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sonal Man Singh** has been nominated by the President of India to become a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha. 
 
• She is the youngest recipient of Padma Bhushan in 1992 and Padma Vibhushan in 2003.
 
• Sonal Mansingh is an Indian classical dancer and Guru Bharatanatyam and Odissi dancing style.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi Puraskar is an award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi, India's National Academy of Music, Dance & Drama. 
 
• The award is given in three categories, namely:
 
 
• Padma Vibhushan for exceptional and distinguished service.
 
• Padma Bhushan for distinguished service of a high order. 
 
• Padma Shri for **distinguished service**.
